mcqs.question: For the Musi Riverfront Development Project in Telangana, what did the Centre clear as Phase 1 assistance?
options: An Asian Development Bank loan of ₹4,100 crore
Lifting of 20 TMCFT of water from Mallannasagar
Development of a 55-km stretch within HMDA limits
Transfer of 100 acres by the Ministry of Defence
mcqs.explanation: The Centre cleared an Asian Development Bank loan of ₹4,100 crore for Phase 1 of the Musi Riverfront Development Project. The 20 TMCFT figure refers to the proposed water transfer, not the financial assistance.
